requiredChanges.change: Specify the immutable per-exact-endpoint SCPI-language commissioning/admission input and its Unknown/emulation rejection before connector acquisition, with equivalent Rust/C# construction examples. The spec currently requires SCPI but does not say how this admission requirement is represented or validated.

Add a concrete procedural acceptance matrix with stable new-model IDs, setup, trigger and assertions for admission/capability isolation, nonfinite requests and healthy follow-up, failed-operation quarantine, concurrent serialization, owned/borrowed close, and genuinely pending query/write cancellation/deadlines. Distinguish inherited SDK proofs from required new-device integration proofs; include 33120 counterpart-query/write failures and 53132 intent preservation.

Bind a concrete external delivery/validation plan to these additions: list shard composition replacement rules (especially removal of active inherited 34401 cases while preserving historical evidence/regressions), static factory/proof entry points, exact SDK/tool pins or frozen baseline reuse, generate/check/TestKit/verify-package commands, and source/packed Linux/Windows x64 x .NET8/10 acceptance matrix. Identify required future coordinated package versions separately from existing public versions. Existing baseline infrastructure is useful but not yet explicitly extended by this packet.

limitations: SPEC review only: no implementation, software execution of new backends, physical validation, merge or publication is asserted.
